|game_text=Deploy on table. Instead of firing Galen's Lightsaber, may 'throw' it to Used Pile: draw destiny; choose up to half that number (round up) of opponent's ability < 3 characters present to be hit. Galen's Fighter may deploy to sites, moves for free (unless relocating), is immune to attrition < 4, and you may use 3 Force to relocate it to a battleground site (as a regular move during your move phase). If it just moved to a site opponent occupies, may take top card of Used Pile into hand (or if it just landed, any one card in Used Pile; reshuffle).

* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009; slip 37)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; copy re-made 20 April 2010, first printing not found). Galen’s Fighter may deploy to sites, moves for free (unless relocating), is immune to attrition < 4, and you may use 3 Force to relocate it to a battleground site (as a regular move during your move phase). If it just moved to a site opponent occupies, may take top card of Used Pile into hand (or if it just landed, any one card in Used Pile; reshuffle).” The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) showed the same text.<ref name="cl-1240_40-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock4Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064721/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock4Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive; same text in every capture to 11 January 2013)</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[If The Trace Was Correct (V) (Errata)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “Galen’s Fighter” to “''Rogue Shadow''” (the starship's new title): “Deploy on table. Instead of firing Galen’s Lightsaber, may ‘throw’ it to Used Pile: draw destiny; choose up to half that number (round up) of opponent’s ability < 3 characters present to be hit. Rogue Shadow may deploy to sites, moves for free (unless relocating), is immune to attrition < 4, and you may use 3 Force to relocate it to a battleground site (as a regular move during your move phase). If it just moved to a site opponent occupies, may take top card of Used Pile into hand (or if it just landed, any one card in Used Pile; reshuffle).”<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee card image prints the same text.
